_comment: Removed a fabricated STATIC_TRIGGERED ON_DEFEND -> INTIMIDATE ability: the card has no intimidate text. The generator hallucinated it from Blade Break equipment (27 cards corpus-wide). LOOK_AT defaults to the OPPONENT and its 'target' was unread, so 'look at the top card of YOUR deck' was looking at the opponent's -- not a dead effect, an information leak pointing the wrong way. The target named a zone but never a player, and the shared target parser refuses to guess one, so the card now says player SELF outright.
